title: #1 Job Title Tip To Get Better Interviews
description:
Focusing on the wrong job title can keep you stuck in your job search.

Teal member Travis Tyler reveals how trying to force himself into job titles that didn't fit his skills led to 13 months of job searching. Once he stopped keyword stuffing his resume and worked with a more targeted approach—aligning potential job titles with his actual skills—he got better interviews and found a new opportunity—fast.

For more details about how Travis started aligning his job search with Teal and found the right fit, head here: https://tealhq.co/3XxaLNc
